def solve(case):
    if "nodes" not in case or "required_symbols" not in case:
        raise ValueError("Missing required fields: nodes or required_symbols")
    
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    
    # Validate nodes have required fields
    for n in nodes:
        for field in ("id", "parent", "symbol", "depth", "removable", "utility"):
            if field not in n:
                raise ValueError(f"Node missing field: {field}")
    
    # Build node lookup and children map
    node_map = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        if n["parent"] is not None:
            if n["parent"] not in node_map:
                raise ValueError(f"Parent {n['parent']} not found for node {n['id']}")
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    # Sort: depth descending, then id ascending (lexicographic)
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    # Track retained nodes
    retained = set(n["id"] for n in nodes)
    removal_order = []
    
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node["id"]
        
        # Skip if not removable
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        
        # Skip if symbol is required
        if node["symbol"] in required_symbols:
            continue
        
        # Skip if has retained children
        if any(c in retained for c in children[nid]):
            continue
        
        # At this point: removable, symbol not required, no retained children
        # Removing this node cannot affect required symbol coverage
        # (its own symbol isn't required, and it has no retained children)
        retained.remove(nid)
        removal_order.append(nid)
    
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removal_order,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted
    }
